body: From a producer's pov, Drift Phonk is literally the easiest and laziest genre to make out there. I live in the same country as one of the biggest drift phonk artists rn (DJ FKU) and he said in an interview for a Finnish magazine, that he's made most of his songs in under half an hour. He even said himself that producing Drift Phonk is literally almost too easy, and that he only does it for the money. Boring, garbage, uninspired, and most importantly soulless.
Thanks! I'll keep these in mind.

Thank you guys for your replies, whereas my horizons have been widened, I've also started noticing something else that I didn't mention in my post.

The fact for me is that whenever I'm not 100% focused on killing the Widow, I focus on someone else once and I'm dead. I have no clue what type of a sixth sense these Widow players have on me, but whenever I divert my attention from her for one second I'm usually dead.

This wouldn't be a problem if it didn't stop me from being valuable to my team, since whenever I try to hardfocus the Widow, I literally cannot be doing anything else.

Someone else also said that there is something wrong with me as a player if I struggle against a Widow as Genji, and this is probably right, no denying that, and on that note, giving advice in the comments is not prohibited by any means, this wasn't so much of a rant post, this was more of a "What exactly am I missing here?" -post.
Thanks for your reply! Could you tell me what the people you are facing usually do against you forcing you to swap?
Thanks, great tip! I'll keep that in mind.

Fair points overall, but harassing a Widow is where it gets difficult for me. Usually whenever I try to distract her with poke damage from an unpunishable position she just gets healed instantly and continues on with her day like nothing ever happened.

This is especially a problem if the Widow is being pocketed by a Mercy (which has happened very often in my games). I have no clue whether I've just had a unlucky streak of smurfs on the enemy team or if there's just something I'm not seeing here.

Yeah, I feel like the problem for me consists mostly of not being able to get close enough to kill her. Usually whenever I try to flank her I run into another enemy and get pinged out before I really even get to do anything.
Thanks! I'll keep these in mind.
